{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the filter conditions
control_mod = trial_df[(trial_df['arm'] == 'control') & (trial_df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check that the 'responded' column is binary (0 or 1)
print("Responded values and counts:", control_mod['responded'].value_counts().to_dict())

# Compute fraction
fraction_responded = control_mod['responded'].mean()

fraction_responded"}
